headline: Reagan and Gorbachev sign the INF Treaty

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen eighty-seven... the Cold War rivals agreed to destroy a whole group of nuclear missiles.

scenes.label: The White House
scenes.caption: Reagan and Gorbachev sign the treaty
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] At the White House, Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev signed the I-N-F Treaty.

scenes.label: missiles destroyed by June 1991
scenes.text: [calmly] By nineteen ninety-one, two thousand six hundred ninety-two missiles were gone.

scenes.label: Missiles destroyed
scenes.caption: Pershing II rocket stages, 1989
scenes.text: [softly] For the first time, the two sides actually cut their nuclear arms... with inspectors checking on both.
